title: Structure and Representations of a Diagrammatic Non-Commutative Tangloid Algebra
summary: We introduce the \emph{tangloid algebra} $\mathcal{T}_n$, a diagrammatic algebra arising from the extended tangloid category $\Ti$, and its subalgebra, the \emph{braidoid algebra} $\mathcal{B}_n$. The construction begins with the unoriented tangloid category $UTC$, inspired by Turaev's theory of knotoids, which is obtained from the unoriented welded tangleoid category $UWTC$ by removing the welded relation while retaining the forbidden moves and imposing some additional relations.
